preconditions: Disposable VM or block-device image with recorded filesystem, mount, cache, SQLite, and kernel versions
Externally controlled hard-power or block-I/O fault boundary
A disposable executor target with an independently observed effect counter
No production authority, data, or target is present
cuts: after durable AG spend before Docket custody acknowledgement
after Docket attempt assignment before executor delivery acknowledgement
after physical effect before executor outcome acknowledgement
after Docket settlement before AG settlement ingestion
procedure: Run preflight.py --profile fault-injection and snapshot the pristine image
For each cut, restore the same source/configuration basis and arm one externally controlled fault
Trigger exactly one occurrence and cut power or I/O at the recorded boundary
Boot read-only for image capture, then clone before recovery
Run SQLite integrity checks, AG deterministic replay, status classification, and exact spend/attempt/settlement accounting
Redeliver only when the authoritative recovery law permits it and independently count physical effects
Record whether recovery is safe replay, exact reconciliation, or safe halt; never coerce ambiguity to success
Seal images or image hashes, fault-controller trace, journals, databases, and target observations
forbidden_shortcuts: logical SQLite reopen represented as storage durability
executor receipt represented as independent physical-effect evidence
